scripts.install:frozen: corepack pnpm --dir worker install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-workspace && corepack pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-workspace
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run install:frozen && corepack pnpm run build:web
scripts.deploy: corepack pnpm --dir worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && corepack pnpm --dir worker exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --dir worker run typecheck && corepack pnpm --dir web run typecheck
scripts.dev:e2e: corepack pnpm run build:web && corepack pnpm --dir worker exec wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run install:frozen && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test:worker && corepack pnpm run build:web && corepack pnpm run test:e2e
